title: 分数等级
problem_statement_md:
考试的结果将按以下规则分级。如果分数：

- **88及以上** => 优秀
- **40-87** => 良好
- **0-39** => 不合格

给你一个程序，输入分数，计算且将相应的结果（**优秀、良好、不合格**)输出到控制台。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]else if[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Тhe result of an exam will be determined as follows։
If the score is
[b]88 and above[/b] => excellent
[b]40-87[/b]   => good
[b]0-39[/b] => fail

You are given a program that takes the [b]score[/b] as input.

[b]Task[/b]
Complete the code to output the corresponding result [b](excellent, good, fail)[/b] to the console.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
78

[b]Sample Output[/b]
good

[note]Use [b]console.log()[/b] to output the result to the console.
Use logical operator [b]&&[/b] to chain multiple conditions.[/note]
hint_md:
- 使用`console.log()`将结果输出到控制台。
- 使用逻辑运算符`&&`来连接多个条件。
